description: This Java class generates loan repayment schedules with cumulative flat interest calculations, extending an abstract schedule generator, and includes methods for calculating principal and interest components per period.

classes.name: CumulativeFlatInterestLoanScheduleGenerator
classes.description: A component class responsible for generating loan schedules with cumulative flat interest calculations, extending AbstractCumulativeLoanScheduleGenerator.

methods.name: getScheduledDateGenerator
methods.description: Returns the scheduled date generator used for creating payment dates.

methods.name: getPaymentPeriodsInOneYearCalculator
methods.description: Returns the calculator for determining payment periods within a year.

methods.name: calculatePrincipalInterestComponentsForPeriod
methods.description: Calculates principal and interest components for a specific payment period, updating cumulative totals, and adjusting for last repayment period if needed.
